## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.
The duplicate adoption output should be fixed because the command now reports each existing setting twice. Tests were read, not run.

## Changes
The planner now returns adoption records and an audit record containing the incoming settings count. Added tests check audit records and their omission from command output.

## Critical
(none)

## Important
- app/planner.py:9 — correctness — Skip adoption records when rendering command changes — Calling `run({"theme": "dark"}, {"theme": "dark"}, emit)` emits “Adopted theme” twice. The planner emits progress at line 8, then the new adoption record reaches the renderer at `app/cli.py:9`, which excludes only audit records. — Users see duplicate progress messages whenever incoming settings already exist, making one adoption appear to occur twice. — Fix: Filter adoption records at `app/cli.py:7` and extend `test_adoption_progress` to exercise `run`.
